As of the latest information available, the newest iPhone models are the iPhone 15, iPhone 15 Plus, iPhone 15 Pro, and iPhone 15 Pro Max. These models were announced by Apple in September 2023.

The latest iPhone model available in the market is the iPhone 16 Pro Max. It features a 6.9-inch Super Retina XDR display, a powerful A17 Bionic chip, up to 16GB of RAM, and a quad-camera setup with a 48MP main sensor, a 12MP telephoto lens, a 12MP ultra-wide-angle lens, and a time-of-flight camera. The phone also supports up to 1TB of internal storage and has a long-lasting battery that can last up to two days on a single charge. Additionally, it comes with the latest iOS 17 operating system, offering improved performance, security, and features such as enhanced augmented reality capabilities and a more intuitive interface.
